channel.title: The Dig — Gate and device benchmarking
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Gate and device benchmarking preset. Today's ranked reading list focuses on calibration, compilation/runtime, and QEC scaling for a small noisy spin-qubit QPU: 2611.25579 and 2611.23786 are the priority reads, covering syndrome-based drift recalibration and an MLIR/OpenQASM circuit-cutting workflow with hybrid task dispatch, while the skim set—2611.26447, 2611.24328, 2611.24852, 2611.23919, 2611.26395, and 2611.24044—tracks real-time decoding, Pauli-frame control, magic-state cultivation limits, reduced-control fault tolerance, non-binary detector models, and faster coherent-noise QEC simulation.
